name: Relay coil with diode suppression
summary: A relay with diode suppression includes a diode associated with its coil to limit the transient on de-energisation.
description: A relay with diode suppression includes a diode associated with its coil to limit the transient on de-energisation. The diode's documented connection makes control polarity important.
readingNotes: Verify the coil and diode polarity using the chosen relay or socket diagram.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A suppression diode protects the control circuit; it is not a contact-side arc suppressor.
